message.text: The element 'Buyer reference' (BT-10) must be transmitted.
'Payment account identifier' (BT-84) should be a correct IBAN when 'Payment means type code' (BT-81) is 58 (SEPA).
The invoice should state the delivery/service date: BT-72 'Actual delivery date', BG-14 'Invoicing period', or BG-26 'Invoice line period' on every line.

fullDescription.text: Add the required element at `cbc:BuyerReference`: Buyer reference (BT-10) must be transmitted (non-empty).
